vulnerability.name: GO-2026-6809
vulnerability.description: crypto/x509 of the Go standard library distrusted too little when it verified a certificate chain (fixed in Go 1.26.10 and 1.27.3).

statements.action_statement: The image of v0.4.1 was built with Go 1.27.2. Upgrade to the next release (see CHANGELOG.md). The binary asset of v0.4.1 was built with Go 1.26.10 and is not affected.

vulnerability.name: CVE-2026-84782
vulnerability.description: OpenSSL: DTLS retransmission reads past a message buffer (in libssl, reported by image scanners as the Debian package libssl3; no fix from Debian at the time of writing).

statements.impact_statement: The vulnerable code is the DTLS retransmission logic in libssl.so.3. The image carries that file only because the distroless base image does; nothing in the image loads it: the program hsmgate links only libc, and the PKCS#11 module (opensc-pkcs11.so, libopensc.so) links libcrypto.so.3, not libssl. hsmgate speaks TLS over TCP with the Go standard library (TLS 1.3 only) and no DTLS at all; OpenSC does no networking.
